key_insight: Lead-free double perovskites K/Rb2SnGeX6 are thermodynamically stable, mechanically ductile, and electronically tunable from wide- to narrow-bandgap for photovoltaics and thermoelectrics.
engineering_relevance: The series offers a single material platform for safer solar absorbers, tandem/NIR optoelectronics, and high-ZT waste-heat recovery devices.
method: DFT-based structural and electronic property calculations
Elastic-constant analysis for mechanical stability and ductility
Transport/thermoelectric analysis including bandgaps, effective masses, and lattice thermal conductivity trends
evidence_signal: The abstract reports all six compounds as stable cubic phases with direct bandgaps tunable from 1.44 to 0.64 eV and a peak thermoelectric performance of ZT = 2.4 for K2SnGeI6 at 1000 K.
watch_item: The results are computational and idealized, so experimental synthesis, phase purity, and defect effects must be validated before device deployment.
paper_title: First-Principles Study of Novel Lead-Free Double Perovskite \b{eta}2SnGeX6 (\b{eta} = K, Rb; X = Cl, Br, I) for thermomechanical, optoelectronic and outstanding thermoelectric applications
